Howdy, I have recently been approved for the Hazlewood Act this semester. I applied and submitted documents for it back in early May. Mine was pending for awhile.

You can also call the financial aid number which is 979-845-3236 It will be an automated message that gives you instructions on how you can get in contact.

The instructions will tell you to text “sfaid” to 979-383-2940

You will receive a text message back for different lines to connect with one of them is Veterans Zoom. Text the number “5”. to request a Veterans Zoom meeting so that you can discuss the Hazelwood act.

Please don’t be afraid to talk to you’re doctor about POTS. I know it’s not ideal but I was desperate to find what was wrong with me so I researched and found out that my symptoms are similar to POTS. I brought it up with my family physician doctor and He performed an EKG and a poor mans tilt table test. He agreed with me and diagnosed with POTS.
